sourceDesc.p: This is a central repository for the collection of scribal hands identified in various manuscript sources. All hands are described here in handNote elements, and pointed to using the prefix hand:.

handNote.name: Douai MS Hand 1
handNote.p: The primary scribal hand used in the Douai MS, which is MS 787 in the Bibliothèque Marceline Desbordes-Valmore repository. The scribe made changes and additions at a later stage.

handNote.name: Douai MS Hand 2
handNote.p: A second, later hand is used in the Douai MS, which is MS 787 in the Bibliothèque Marceline Desbordes-Valmore repository. It is responsible for the insertion of stage directions. This later hand is smaller, thinner, and more slanting than the main scribal hand. It does not appear in Macbeth.

handNote.name: Douai MS Hand 3
handNote.p: A word by a third hand is added to the text of Julius Caesar in the Douai MS, which is MS 787 in the Bibliothèque Marceline Desbordes-Valmore repository.

handNote.name: Douai MS Hand 4
handNote.p: A fourth hand appears in the Douai MS, that of the Librarian, in Twelfth Night.

handNote.name: Douai MS Hand 5
handNote.p: A fifth hand in the Douai MS numbers a previously unnumbered folio in As You Like It (37Bis).

revisionDesc.change: Added names for each of the hands
